in_marathi.name: Nakuul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nakuul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nakula is a heroic and powerful warrior in Indian mythology. Derived from the Sanskrit language, the name Nakuul means 'Lord of the Sky'. He is also referred to as Nakula-Sahadeva, a significant character in the epic Mahabharata.

vedic_reference.note: Nakuul is a Sanskrit name of Hindu origin, derived from the Sanskrit word 'nakula', which means 'younger brother of Bhima'. In Hindu mythology, Nakula is one of the five Pandava brothers, and is also known as Sahadeva or Bhima's younger brother.
